[EN] Distasteful Duty
[ES] Deber desagradable
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] This is the worst part of the job.
[ES] Esta es la peor parte del trabajo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rest in peace, my friends...
[ES] Descansen en paz, amigos míos...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Execute the enthralled workers near the camp. Be merciful.
[ES] Ejecuta a los trabajadores subyugados cerca del campamento. Sé piadoso.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "They didn't suffer long."
[ES] "No sufrieron mucho tiempo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Tibod at the Embattled Outpost.
[ES] Informa a Tibod en el Puesto Avanzado Acosado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
